consumer.required: Separate nonthrowing intrinsic actual-view ByteLength; keep the existing throwing lease contract unchanged. Actual view brand is checked first; detached/OOB length zero reaches the original native bounds assertion.

contract: The caller performs its actual brand predicate first. This intrinsic borrows the view, reads current backing length, maps detached/OOB to zero, floors typed-array tracking spans to element width, and leaves pending state untouched. The existing throwing lease remains unchanged.
